title: Puzzle header
description: A pinned two-tier header: a lavender announcement strip with a bold lead-in, a link and a close cross, over a powder nav bar with a green-tiled wordmark, chevroned menu links that turn violet on hover, an ink demo button, a soft violet trial button and a sign-in link. On phones: wordmark, the violet button and a burger that opens a full-width link panel.
notes: sticks to the top of the page (position: sticky), so put it directly in the page container
no JavaScript: the strip closes through a hidden checkbox, the phone menu is a native <details>
name: puzzle-header

props.name: announcement
props.type: { lead: string; text: string; shortText?: string; link: { label: string; href: string; }; }
props.description: the lavender strip above the nav; leave out for none

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for the strip's close cross

props.name: brand
props.type: { name: string; href: string; icon?: ReactNode; }
props.description: the wordmark: a name with a small icon on a green tile

props.name: signIn
props.description: the plain link at the far right (desktop)

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for the phone menu button
